name: fruit_weigh
text: A fruit seller makes one continuous right-arm transfer across a counter. Lift a grapefruit from the counter with the right hand, keep it raised above the counter while moving it sideways to the weighing tray on the right, then lower it onto the tray and release it. Keep the right hand high between picking up and setting down. The left arm hangs relaxed. Do not switch hands or rest between pickup and placement.
